resources.string: Forces Android’s UI renderer (HWUI / Skia) to Vulkan or OpenGL ES, the same debug.hwui.renderer switch used by GAMA. Vulkan often uses less power and runs cooler; OpenGL is the fallback if Vulkan glitches. Apps and games can still pick their own API. A reboot clears the property unless restore on boot is on and Shizuku or root is available. If the screen freezes, hold Volume down and Power.
Needs Shizuku, root, or ADB (copy the command below)
No Shizuku or root — use ADB
Re-applies Vulkan or OpenGL after boot when Shizuku or root is available. Android always clears the property on reboot.
Renderer applied. Some screens may need a reboot.
Could not apply. Grant Shizuku, use root, or run:\n%1$s
Lets the home-screen System widget change Vulkan or OpenGL. Off by default. Needs Shizuku, root, or ADB.
Turn on “Switch from System widget” in Settings → Advanced → Graphics API first
Off by default. When on, you can add the System widget (Vulkan, RAM, Network) from the widget picker.
